decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Design &amp; Access Statement,
Fire Statement dated September 11, 2024/021/2 REV P0 (Existing and Proposed
Plans), 2024/021/2 REV P0 (Site and block map), 2024/23 REV P0 (Existing and Proposed
Elevations), 2024/23 REV P0 (Existing and Proposed Elevations (Side)), 2024/23
REV P0 (3D Views).<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family:
&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p>The
use hereby approved as an MOT Testing Station shall be carried out by using a
prior appointment booking system only unless otherwise agreed in writing by the
Local Planning Authority.</p>

The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:-&nbsp;(a) 0800 hours to 1800
hours, Monday to Friday inclusive, (b) 0800 hours to 1300 hours on Saturdays,
with no use permitted on Sundays or Bank Holidays,&nbsp;without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.

<p>The use hereby
permitted shall not commence until a scheme for the storage and disposal of
refuse/waste has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local
planning authority. The use hereby approved shall not commence until the works
have been completed in accordance with the approved details and shall
thereafter be retained.</p>
Storage shall not take place anywhere within the application site except within the building(s).

No sewage or trade effluent, including cooling water containing chemical additives, or vehicle washing water, including steam cleaning effluent, shall be discharged to the surface water drainage system.

<p>Any
plant and machinery which may be used by reason of granting this permission,
shall be so installed, used and thereafter retained as to prevent the
transmission of noise and vibration into any neighbouring premises.</p>

The premises shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no other purpose, including any other purpose in Class B2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification).

<p>The use hereby
permitted shall not commence until details of bicycle storage has been
submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The
use hereby approved shall not commence until the&nbsp; bicycle storage shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The use hereby permitted shall not commence
until an application to provide a new, and/or to widen the existing vehicle
crossover shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council’s
Vehicle Crossings Officer within the Network Management Team. The approved
written confirmation from the Vehicle Crossings Officer, as well as the full
details of the vehicle crossover shall then be submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority. The use hereby permitted shall not
commence until the works have been completed in accordance with the approved
details and shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
description: Change of use and conversion from Class B2 (general industrial) / Class B8 (storage or distribution) to MOT centre (sui generis) on ground floor level
